text: Source shall be valid UTF-8 containing Unicode scalar values. A BOM shall be accepted and ignored only at the start. Malformed encoding, surrogate scalars, and out-of-range code points shall be rejected without replacement.
clause_basis: Conservative sentence/semicolon seed groups; semantic clause review required before closure.
